name: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam
summary: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam worked in Indian aerospace and later became a public educator and president of India.

facts.text: Kalam was project director for India's first Satellite Launch Vehicle, SLV-3, which placed the Rohini satellite in orbit in 1980.
facts.context: The achievement shows how long technical programs depend on patient coordination, engineering discipline, and public purpose.
